column1: # Mode streamer: overlay di dalam game
Menampilkan gagang kecil di tepi kiri layar game. Ketuk untuk membuka panel yang menampilkan dan menyembunyikan overlay.
column2: Shows a small handle on the left edge of the game screen. Tap it to open a panel that shows and hides overlays.

column1: Teks, gambar, link dengan kode QR, dan timer yang tampil di atas game.
column2: Text, images, links with a QR code, and timers shown on top of the game.

column1: Belum ada overlay. Tambahkan di Pengaturan > Game > Mode streamer > Atur overlay.
column2: No overlays yet. Add some in Settings > Game > Streamer mode > Set up overlays.

column1: Tampilkan teks, gambar, link, atau timer di atas game. Buka dan sembunyikan lewat panel di tepi kiri layar saat bermain.
column2: Show text, images, links, or timers on top of the game. Show and hide them from the panel on the left edge of the screen while playing.

column1: Belum ada overlay. Ketuk Tambah untuk membuatnya.
column2: No overlays yet. Tap Add to create one.

column1: Penonton bisa memindainya langsung dari layar.
column2: Viewers can scan it right from the screen.

column1: Alamat ini terlalu panjang untuk kode QR, jadi hanya tulisannya yang tampil.
column2: This address is too long for a QR code, so only the text is shown.

column1: Timer mulai dari 00:00. Mulai, jeda, dan reset-nya lewat panel di tepi kiri layar saat bermain.
column2: The timer starts at 00:00. Start, pause, and reset it from the panel on the left edge of the screen while playing.

column1: Bila mati, nyalakan lewat panel di tepi kiri layar saat bermain.
column2: If off, turn it on from the panel on the left edge of the screen while playing.

column1: Foto atau logo. Dikecilkan otomatis supaya ringan.
column2: A photo or logo. It is resized automatically to stay light.

column1: Kotak di belakang tulisan. Matikan supaya tulisannya polos.
column2: A box behind the text. Turn off for plain text.

column1: Gambar hanya bisa diganti dari layar utama: Pengaturan > Game > Mode streamer > Atur overlay.
column2: Images can only be changed from the main screen: Settings > Game > Streamer mode > Set up overlays.

column1: Seret overlay untuk memindahkan, cubit untuk mengubah ukuran.
column2: Drag an overlay to move it, pinch to resize.
